description: Baogao Yizhan aggregates tens of millions of research reports from hundreds of global research institutions, together with global company filings, U.S. SEC filings, global earnings calls, academic papers, public roadshows, charts and bilingual research materials. RAG-based structuring reduces token use and improves retrieval efficiency and research accuracy.

display.description_en: Baogao Yizhan aggregates tens of millions of research reports from hundreds of global research institutions, together with global company filings, U.S. SEC filings, global earnings calls, academic papers, public roadshows, charts and bilingual research materials. RAG-based structuring reduces token use and improves retrieval efficiency and research accuracy.
display.description_zh: 聚合数百家全球研究机构的千万级研报，并整合全球公司公告、美国SEC 文件，全球公司业绩会、学术论文，公开路演及图表，双语资料。经 RAG 结构化处理，减少 Token 消耗，提升检索效率和投研回答准确率。
examples_en: Find Chinese and global research on 300750 from the last month and summarize supporting and risk views.
Compare the core data-center revenue assumptions in the two latest NVIDIA reports.
Summarize how Microsoft's latest 10-Q, earnings call and research reports explain Azure growth.
Find recent charts and tables about AI data-center capital expenditure with source attribution.
examples_zh: 检索 300750 最近一个月的中外研报，并归纳支持与风险观点。

汇总 Microsoft 最近一季 10-Q、业绩会和研报对 Azure 增长的解释。
查找最近讨论 AI 数据中心资本开支的图表和表格，并注明来源。
